description: Search the full PDL Company Dataset with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string over the Company Schema (e.g. all SaaS companies with 50-200 employees in the US). Paginate with scroll_token. Each returned record costs 1 credit. API: POST /company/search.

query.description: Elasticsearch query as a JSON string, e.g. {"query":{"term":{"industry":"computer software"}}} — pass the value of "query".

scroll_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response.

size.description: Number of records to return (1-100). Default 1.

sql.description: SQL query string, e.g. SELECT * FROM company WHERE industry='computer software'.

name: pdl_company_search
title: Search companies
